contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IM CAE MAGN-ENTI]VS PF AVG ; R/ FELICITAS [REIPVBLICAE]

A contemporary copy of a nummus of Magnentius (AD 350-353) a FELICITAS-REI PVBLICE reverse type. Believed to be Trier mint. Reference is RIC VIII, p.158, no 264. Obverse description: Draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: [IM CAE MAGN-ENTI]VS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor in military dress standing left, holding victory on a globe and standard with Chi-Rho banner. Reverse…
